title: S&P 500 -- The Two Towers
author: hairy_zub
selftext:
>[2 Timothy 2:7 Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.](https://www.tradingview.com/x/YUYb08Qs/)

>**Hebrews 11:6** *But without faith it is impossible to please Him: for he that cometh to God must believe that He is, and that He is a rewarder of them that diligently seek Him.*

>**Isaiah 33:6** *And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is His treasure.*

>**Daniel 11:32** *The people that do know their God shall be strong, and do daring feats of valor.*
